expected_outcome.description: A report that notices the question does not say which timeout is meant and finishes anyway, without waiting for a reply: it states which reading it took (or says plainly that it is answering for each timeout in the code) and answers with evidence. The three timeouts are the HTTP request timeout (`src/http/client.ts:1`, 8 seconds, applied at line 4), the job timeout (`src/jobs/worker.ts:1`, 60 seconds, applied at line 4) and the database connect timeout (`src/db.ts:5`, 3 seconds). Answering for one reading with the others briefly noted, or for all three, are both fine.
